strings.每隔一定时间对全场敌人造成一定时间的<$ba.cold>寒冷</>: At regular intervals, inflicts <$ba.cold>Cold</> on all enemies on the field for a set time
strings.根据当前层数最高的盟约获得强化：每层盟约层数使自身攻击速度<@ba.vup>+1: Empowered according to the alliance with the most stacks: each alliance stack gives it ASPD <@ba.vup>+1</>, and its attacks additionally inflict <@ba.vup>0.1%</> <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> for 2 seconds (up to 300 stacks)
strings.改变敌人的行进路线\n<@ba.rem>如果阻隔工事阻挡了敌人，敌人会破坏此工事:
Changes the enemies' route
<@ba.rem>If a Roadblock blocks an enemy, the enemy will destroy it</>
strings.可将高台干员部署于其上: Ranged Operators can be deployed on it
strings.战场#05(上半) 涨潮/特制水上平台: Battlefield #05 (First Half) Rising Tide/Custom Floating Platform
strings.在水上建立可以部署<@ba.vup>任意</>单位的平台: Constructs a platform on the water upon which <@ba.vup>any</> unit can be deployed
strings.加固状态：阻挡<@ba.vup>沙尘暴</>，不再受到<@ba.vup>沙尘暴<: Fortified state: Blocks the <@ba.vup>Sandstorm</>, no longer receives damage from the <@ba.vup>Sandstorm</>, but can still be instantly destroyed by <High-Energy Originium Bomb>.
strings.不会受到攻击，遮挡我方单位的视野: Cannot be attacked, and blocks the vision of your units
strings.向前方3格吹出气流；与气流<@ba.vup>同向</>/<@ba.vdown>逆: Blows out an airflow towards the 3 frontal tiles; Operators deployed <@ba.vup>downstream</>/<@ba.vdown>upstream</> from the airflow have <@ba.vup>increased</>/<@ba.vdown>decreased</> ATK; Enemies moving <@ba.vdown>downstream</>/<@ba.vup>upstream</> from the airflow have <@ba.vdown>increased</>/<@ba.vup>decreased</> Movement Speed
strings.向前方3格吹出气流；与气流同向/逆向部署的干员攻击提升/降低；同向/逆向移动的敌: Blows out an airflow towards the 3 frontal tiles; Operators deployed downstream/upstream from the airflow have increased/decreased ATK; Enemies moving downstream/upstream from the airflow have increased/decreased Movement Speed
